published_prior_art.cite: Huwang1995 gives a rare-binomial normal-coverage failure, not causal randomized likelihood-ratio inversion.
TianWu2025 gives fixed-law efficient PN/PS inference under monotonicity, not the stated smoothness--rarity transfer region.
TianWu2025 is regular fixed-law PN/PS inference; MikushevaSun2022 is uniform jackknifed AR inversion for many-weak linear IV, neither supplies this rare-PN frontier.
GleserHwang1987 supplies the general expected-diameter impossibility template, but not the certified monotone PN submodel.
HannartNaveau2018 and KirilioukNaveau2020 optimize climate causal evidence but do not give selection-honest learned-score likelihood-ratio inversion.

novelty_flags.label: Conjecture 1
novelty_flags.one_line: The flagship comparison names TianWu2025 and MikushevaSun2022 without placing a section, equation, page, or quoted open-problem anchor in the statement-level gap.

soundness_flags.label: Theorem 2, Conjecture 1, and Theorem 3
soundness_flags.one_line: These sample-based coverage and expected-diameter assertions are written under the one-observation law P_n although the random sets depend on Z_n; state probabilities and expectations under P_n^{\otimes n} and explicitly include ass:iid-row.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: Theorem 1
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: Exact randomized coverage is claimed only for the finite empirical-support profiling experiment Xi_n(t), not for arbitrary continuous Hölder laws.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Finite-experiment validity conditional on membership in the stated finite experiment.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: Theorem 2
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: Gaussian likelihood transfer and shrinking diameter are restricted to the attainable class M_n^{LAN}.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Gaussian recovery only for P_n in M_n^{LAN}, where the stated rare-scale remainder condition holds.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Write every data-dependent probability and expectation under P_n^{\otimes n}, add ass:iid-row to the relevant dependencies, and define the precise transfer relation between the finite profiling experiment and the continuous Hölder law.
Put verifiable locations for TianWu2025 and MikushevaSun2022 directly beside Conjecture 1, and position ZhangWangMiao2025 explicitly as the nearby partial-identification inference comparator.

Sharpen the all-regime conjecture into a necessary-and-sufficient smoothness--rarity frontier by adding a nuisance-learning lower bound outside M_n^{LAN}, rather than only the effective-count lower bound.

recommended_next_step: Revise the sample-law notation and comparator anchors, then re-run the novelty review.
